cause.established: The verb exists in the application layer and was never wired into the command surface. DeliveryRouteApplication.run implements an offline `route validate <subject> <record.json>` and nothing dispatches to it; Options.fs:1963 routes `delivery-route` to `deliveryRouteCmd`, which handles only `show` and `record`.

redToday.found: During a pass that authored thirteen receipts there was no way to check one without attempting a live board write. grep -rn "DeliveryRouteApplication" src/ --include=*.fs returns only the module definition and two decodeStructured call sites.

derivedBy.notSearched: An adjudicator should check whether a gate already derives 'an application verb with no command-surface dispatch'.

classRow.notSearched: This may be evidence on a wiring/coverage class row rather than a row of its own.

whyNotHere: The route pass held no claim and no lane by construction -- recording a receipt is not a claim -- and the fix is in engine source, outside anything that pass declared.
